zh-Hans: 让你见识的不是 EVO IV 有多厉害，而是我的技术有多厉害！
en: I'll show you how good my skills are, not how good the EVO IV is!

zh-Hans: 开着 EVO IV，凭什么还得跟在后面慢吞吞地跑？！
en: Why the hell am I crawling along behind him in an EVO IV?!

zh-Hans: 真看不顺眼，越看越火大！
en: I don't like this. It's pissing me off!
Get out of my way, damn it!
This is so damn frustrating!

zh-Hans: 我和 EVO IV 的字典里，可没有“半油门”这三个字！
en: Part throttle isn't in my vocabulary, or my EVO IV's!
Stop crawling around in my way!
You're an eyesore!
D-damn it!

zh-Hans: 比想象中还会跑啊，原来是这么回事！
en: You're better than I thought. So that's how it is!

zh-Hans: 难道过弯时，我还稍微慢一点？！
en: Am I actually a little slower in the corners?!
D-damn it!
Tch! What the hell was that?!
Hah!
Grr...
Damn it!
You've got to be kidding!

zh-Hans: 这到底算什么！开什么玩笑！
en: What the hell is this?! You've got to be kidding!

zh-Hans: 为什么？那种速度到底怎么回事？！
en: Why? Where's that speed coming from?!

zh-Hans: 烦死了，根本没法集中精神！
en: This is driving me mad! I can't concentrate!

zh-Hans: 我就用技术拉开差距，不靠车的性能！
en: I'll make the difference with my driving, not the car's performance!

zh-Hans: 就这样全力猛冲，让你从后视镜里消失！
en: I'll keep charging at full throttle until you're gone from my mirror!

zh-Hans: 不但没被甩开，反而贴上来了！
en: He's not dropping back. He's right on me!
Impossible!
He can keep up with my drifting?!

zh-Hans: 真丢脸，竟然甩不掉？连我的技术加 EVO 的动力都不行？！
en: This is humiliating. I can't shake him? Not even with my skills and the EVO's power?!

zh-Hans: 这样才对！刚才抢到前面，绝对没错！
en: This was the right call! Taking the lead back there wasn't a mistake!
I'm the one who's going to win, Kyoichi!
Damn it, I can't take any more! Go!

zh-Hans: 京一，不按模拟方案三又怎样？只要赢了，你就没话说吧！
en: Who cares about Simulation Three, Kyoichi? As long as I win, you can't complain!

zh-Hans: 只要我想超，轻轻松松就能到前面！
en: If I want to pass, I can take the lead with ease!

zh-Hans: 看见了吧？接下来才让你见识实力差距！
en: See that? Now you'll find out just how far apart we are!
Now that's a relief!
Hmph. You had me worried for a second.
That's how it's done!
Come on, come on!
What's wrong? Is that all you've got?
Hah! Pathetic!
Got you!

zh-Hans: 群马这边的水平，真够低的！
en: Gunma's racers are pathetic!
This guy isn't worth talking about.

zh-Hans: 我百分之百确定，只要不犯大错，这场我就赢定了！
en: I'm a hundred percent sure. Unless I make a huge mistake, this battle is mine!

zh-Hans: 那种速度到底怎么回事？！
en: Where's that speed coming from?!

zh-Hans: 赌上 EVO 车手的骄傲，我也要把你甩掉！
en: With my pride as an EVO driver on the line, I'll leave you in the dust!
